text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the deafening cheers, the Arima 
Kinen champion, Daiwa Scarlet—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in congratulations inside the 
Winner's Circle, she wept, before breaking 
into a smile as she headed toward the 
awards ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On this day, in the eyes of the 
spectators, she was truly the "number one" 
Umamusume.
